channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Busy Christmas puts winemaker Chapel Down ahead of expectations
item.description: Kent winemaker Chapel Down has exceeded its anticipated annual revenues following strong Christmas trading.

item.title: "Resilient" performance for Henry Boot despite "uncertain backdrop"
item.description: Listed land promotion, property investment and development, and housebuilding group Henry Boot has reported a "resilient" performance in 2025 against an "uncertain backdrop".

item.title: Results light up at Luceco in "another year of strong growth"
item.description: LED lighting maker Luceco is upbeat after "another year of strong growth" in which revenues and profits increased.

item.title: Microlise boss "excited by the scale of opportunity ahead" after revenue upturn
item.description: The chief executive of Microlise, a Nottingham-headquartered provider of transport management software to fleet operators, said he is "excited by the scale of opportunity ahead" after a slight upturn in revenues.

item.title: South Bristol’s tallest-ever building plans blocked amid 'height' concerns
item.description: A contentious scheme to create what would be the tallest ever building in South Bristol has been blocked by planners amid fierce opposition.

item.title: H&M reveals subdued winter sales after annual profit hike
item.description: Fast fashion retail giant H&M has brushed off a “challenging environment” to deliver a jump in annual earnings, but revealed a recent sales slowdown amid subdued shopper demand over Christmas.

item.title: US company to invest £600m in Humber sustainable aviation fuel plant - set to create hundreds of jobs
item.description: A US carbon recycling company is set to invest £600m in a sustainable aviation fuel facility on the Humber that could create hundreds of jobs.

item.title: Plans submitted for 176 new homes and green space in Stockport
item.description: Bellway has submitted a detailed planning application for 176 new homes on land at Jacksons Lane in Hazel Grove, Stockport.

item.title: Birmingham-based comms consultancy appoints new Director
item.description: Birmingham-based communications consultancy Whistle PR has announced the promotion of Amy Ahmed-Dolphin to Director, strengthening its senior leadership team as the agency targets ambitious growth over the coming years.

item.title: Brunch-focused café group primed for job-creating expansion with PE backing
item.description: A café group focused on brunches has secured investment from Foresight Group, a regional private equity and real assets manager which has previously backed high-profile hospitality brands.
